question: Which of the following states will host 2023 Men’s Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Odisha__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Odisha,** known for its significant contributions to promoting hockey in India, hosted the** 2023 Men's Hockey World Cup**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• This decision** underscores **the state's dedication to enhancing sports infrastructure & fostering talent in hockey
 
• **Odisha has previously hosted major hockey events,** demonstrating its capability & commitment to successfully organizing international sports tournaments.
 
• Hosting the** World Cup showcases Odisha's hockey passion** and position as a top destination for international sports events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Men's Hockey Cup**

 
 
• **​**Men’s FIH Hockey World Cup is an international field hockey 
 
• It was** first started in ****1971**** **and is held every four years
 
• **Pakistan** is the most successful team, having won the tournament **four times**.
 
• **Belgium** and **India** have both won the tournament once.
